items.title: 75230_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, we played together a lot. I think we made some records together, too.

ctx.x: You say upstairs. Do you mean the Streets of Paris was a below-level club...

Yeah. But it was downstairs. Which was nice. And I could go in and hear Garner whenever I wanted to. It was very nice. It was much better than the Jade Room, because in the Jade Room the only thing I could hear was them old-time tunes, and God knows, I was sick of hearing them. Because I done played "Sweet Georgia Brown" so much and all the traditional tunes that they played... I come up playing that stuff. So I mean, like, I was glad to get away from that.

items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: They wouldn't let Erroll and I play together. ... Or on the same night...? Yeah, he would sit in... I would have liked to hear that. In fact, I tried to egg it on a couple of times, but it didn't happen.
